landing.hero.headline: The headless engine for your next SaaS.
landing.hero.subheadline: Auth, payments, subscriptions, credits, RBAC, CMS, and i18n — all pre-wired. Just build your product on top.
landing.features.title: Everything you need to ship
landing.features.description: Pre-wired business logic so you can focus on building your product.
landing.features.auth.title: Authentication
landing.features.auth.description: Email/password, Google, and GitHub OAuth — ready out of the box with session management and account linking.
landing.features.payment.title: Payments
landing.features.payment.description: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay — checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, and order management.
landing.features.rbac.title: Roles & Permissions
landing.features.rbac.description: Fine-grained RBAC with wildcard matching. Full admin panel for managing users, roles, and permissions.
landing.features.i18n.title: Internationalization
landing.features.i18n.description: English and Chinese built-in with locale-aware routing. Easy to extend with additional languages.
landing.features.cms.title: Content Management
landing.features.cms.description: Categories and posts with full CRUD, status management, and admin panel — build your blog or docs.
landing.features.credits.title: Credit System
landing.features.credits.description: FIFO consumption, expiration, auto-grant on signup, and revocation — ready for usage-based billing.
landing.pricing.title: Pricing
landing.pricing.description: Choose the plan that works for you.
landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: Everything you need to know before getting started.
landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Stripe, PayPal, Creem, Alipay, and WeChat Pay out of the box. The PaymentManager abstraction makes it straightforward to add more providers by implementing a single interface.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Yes. uncensored ai is built for creating production-ready video experiences. You retain full control over your project and workflow.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to ship your SaaS?
landing.cta.subheadline: Stop piecing together a generic video workflow. Start with uncensored ai and create work that is unmistakably yours.

Start fast with 1K drafts, move to 2K when a frame is ready to refine, and choose from 13 native aspect ratios for social, product, presentation, and campaign formats. Each task shows its credit cost, so it is easy to compare ideas, iterate deliberately, and download the results you want to keep.
proactiv.workflow.eyebrow: No credit card. No watermark. No catch.
proactiv.workflow.title: Truly Free – No Credit Card, No Watermark
proactiv.workflow.description: Free means free here — not free for three images, then pay up. There is no trial period, no hidden fee, and no premium tier waiting to activate. You never enter a credit card, because there is nothing to buy. Every image comes out clean: no logos, no watermarks, no semi-transparent branding over the corner of your work. Download as many pictures as you want, at full quality, and use them however you like. A free uncensored AI image editor should never tax your creativity.

proactiv.pricing.faq_records:
How are image credits calculated?||Every task follows one simple rule: its base cost is multiplied by 7, then rounded up to a whole credit before it starts.
What does a default image cost?||A default 1K Medium image costs 22 credits. 1K Low costs 15; 2K Low costs 22; and 2K Medium costs 29.
Do reference images cost extra?||Each reference image adds 0.51 base credits per request. With the 7× rule, that is 3.57 credits per image before the task total rounds up; use up to three references.
What can I create?||Create images from text or edit with reference images. Choose 1K or 2K, Low or Medium quality, and 13 aspect ratios plus automatic framing.
What happens when a task fails?||Failed, rejected, and cancelled tasks are refunded. Credits are reserved before submission and returned if the task does not complete.
When should I download results?||Generated image links remain valid for 24 hours. Download the results you want to keep.
How do monthly and annual plans work?||Monthly plans grant their listed credits on each successful renewal. Annual plans are billed once and grant the complete annual allocation at checkout.
proactiv.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
proactiv.faq.records:
Is this tool really completely free?||Yes — completely. There is no trial period, no hidden charges, and no premium tier. Every feature is available from your very first image: unlimited generations, high-definition output, one-click downloads, and zero watermarks. You will never see a paywall, a credit balance, or an “upgrade to continue” message. Open the editor, generate what you need, and download it — free today, free tomorrow.
Do I need to register or sign in to an account?||No. There is no account system at all — no sign-up form, no email verification, no social login, no password. The editor loads ready to use, and access is never gated behind a membership. This also protects your privacy: without an account, there is no profile tying your prompts or images to an identity. Open the page and start creating immediately.
What kind of content can I generate? Are there any limits?||This is an uncensored editor in the technical sense: there is no blanket content filter rewriting or rejecting your prompts, and creative freedom is the default. Mature themes between consenting adults are allowed as legitimate creative work. We do refuse certain categories: content involving minors, non-consensual or deceptive depictions of real people, and anything else illegal. Those limits exist for legal and ethical reasons, not to censor ordinary creativity.
Who owns the copyright of the images I generate?||You do. Every image you generate belongs to you, not to us. Treat your outputs as your own creative work: keep them, edit them, publish them, or build on them. We make no ownership claim and add no watermark that would complicate using the files. As with any AI-generated media, check the rules of the platform where you publish — but between you and this site, the pictures are yours.
Can I use the generated images for commercial projects?||Yes, with no restrictions from us. Use your images in commercial work — product mockups, ads, social media, book covers, game assets, client deliverables — however you like. There is no license fee, no attribution requirement, and no commercial tier to unlock. You made the image with your prompt, so the usage decision is yours. Just make sure the content itself complies with the laws and platform policies that apply to your industry.
How fast is image generation?||Fast — typically a few seconds per image. There is no queue, no rendering slot to wait for, and no “position in line” counter. You press generate, the model works, and the finished picture appears almost immediately. That speed makes iteration practical: when a result is close but not perfect, adjusting a word or two and regenerating costs less time than finishing your coffee.
How is this different from DALL·E or Midjourney?||Those are capable tools that require an account and a paid subscription, and they apply platform content policies that filter prompts and outputs. This editor is free, requires no sign-up, applies no content-filtering layer, and needs no installation — the differences are structural, not a judgment. If you already pay for a subscription service, this is a fast, zero-commitment alternative for everyday image generation without the gatekeeping.
Are my prompts and generated images stored or made public?||No. We do not publish your prompts or generations to a public gallery, and nothing is tied to an identity because there are no accounts. Your inputs are used to render your image and then discarded — generate, download, move on. We do not build a profile on you, never ask for personal details, and have nothing to sell, since the service is free. What you create here stays yours alone.
What image styles can I generate?||Nearly any style you can describe. Photorealistic portraits and landscapes, anime and manga characters, digital illustration, 3D renders, oil painting and watercolor effects, cyberpunk and sci-fi concept art, logos and icons, product photography, pixel art. Style comes from your prompt — name the aesthetic, reference an era or medium, or describe lighting and mood. Experiment freely: unlimited generations make it easy to try one idea in five styles and keep the best.
What resolution and image quality can I expect?||Every image renders in high definition by default — sharp, clean, and ready to download immediately at full quality, with no watermark and no downscaling. The output suits social posts, blog headers, presentations, and most design work as-is. Larger-format and ultra-high-definition enhancement options are on our roadmap for creators who need print-scale files. For now, enjoy straightforward HD output on every generation at no cost.
How do I use it? Do I need to download software?||Nothing to download and nothing to install — it runs in your browser on desktop, phone, or tablet. Three steps: open the site, type a prompt describing your image, and press generate. Your picture appears in seconds; click download to save it. That is it. No app store, no updates, no storage space used. Bookmark the page and the full editor is always one tap away on any device.
Is there a limit on how many images I can generate?||No limit. Generate as many images as you want, as often as you want — the editor does not cap daily usage or meter generations. Made a hundred variations to find the perfect one? That is normal here. There are no credits to ration, no cooldown timers, and no session limits. The tool is free and unlimited by design, so quantity is limited only by how much you feel like creating.
